entries.title: Ohio Casino Control Commission issues October 2, 2026 cease-and-desist letters to ten sports-event-contract operators, demanding written confirmation of compliance within fourteen days
entries.facts: The Ohio Casino Control Commission, over the signature of Interim Executive Director Andromeda Morrison, issued cease-and-desist letters dated October 2, 2026 to ten operators of sports event contracts: UDM, LLC d/b/a Underdog Predict and Underdog Exchange DCM, Inc.; Gemini Titan, LLC; Coinbase, Inc.; Prophet X; Novig Betting, Inc. and Ludlow Exchange, LLC; Robinhood Derivatives, LLC; QC Tech LLC / Polymarket; Plus500US Financial Services, LLC; Moomoo Financial Inc.; and Webull Financial LLC. The letters state that because each recipient “is offering unlicensed sports gaming and bookmaking,” the Commission “demands that [the recipient] cease and desist from offering … sports event contracts in Ohio,” and cite Ohio Revised Code sections 3775.01(N)(1), 3775.01(O)(1), 3775.01(DD), 3775.02(A), 3775.03(A) and 3775.99(B)(9), together with R.C. Chapter 2915 on bookmaking, R.C. Chapter 3767 on nuisance abatement, and the civil penalty provisions at R.C. 3775.02(H)(1)(a), R.C. 3772.04(B) and Ohio Adm.Code 3775-1-08. Each letter requires written notification to the Commission confirming compliance “no later than fourteen (14) days following the date of this letter,” and states that non-compliance may result in the Commission “pursuing all legal remedies and actions … including, but not limited to, administrative, civil, nuisance, or criminal actions pursuant to R.C. Chapters 2915, 3767, and 3775.” As reported on October 5, 2026 by Covers, InGame and Sportsbetting Dime, the fourteen-day compliance date is October 16, 2026; the letters themselves print the fourteen-day period rather than a calendar date. The combined letters were retrieved in full from a media-hosted copy; the Commission’s own newsroom carried no release on the action as of October 6, 2026, and no Ohio government-hosted copy of the letters was located.
